changelog: Film-night blocks now advance through their selected films at every weekly occurrence, including multiple occurrences in one week. The base schedule resumes correctly after a film instead of repeating the preceding episode. Collapsed block rows show the current film's measured runtime, and proof-of-origin diagnostics now distinguish held, expired and missing tokens without sentinel quality values.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
